		location:chan_chan = {

# Celestial Masters; ANTIQVITAS master plan §9; CAM-CM; recipient=HAN
antq_m10_second.2010 = {
	type = country_event
	title = antq_m10_second.2010.title
	desc = antq_m10_second.2010.desc
	outcome = neutral
	fire_only_once = yes
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event/antq_celestial_masters.dds"
	dynamic_historical_event = {
		tag = XAR
		from = 142.1.1
		to = 143.1.1
		monthly_chance = 100
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10_second.2010.a
		historical_option = yes
		set_variable = antq_m10_celestial_masters_chronicle_path
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
			modifier = { factor = 1.24 stability >= 20 }
			modifier = { factor = 0.84 at_war = yes }
		}
		religion:antq_daoism = {
			enable_religion = yes
			create_holy_site = { name = antq_daoist_chengdu_community type = pilgrimage_city importance = 5 location = location:chengdu religions = { religion:antq_daoism } }
			create_holy_site = { name = antq_daoist_hanzhong_community type = sanctuary importance = 4 location = location:nanzheng religions = { religion:antq_daoism } }
		}
		# CAM-CM: bounded Chengdu-basin seed for the organized Celestial Masters current.
		location:chengdu = {
			every_pop = {
				limit = { religion = religion:antq_chinese_state_cult }
				split_pop = { fraction = 0.03 religion = religion:antq_daoism }
			}
		}
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		# Learned practice shapes the response; it never gates the current.
		if = {
			limit = { has_advance = antq_cosmopolitan_cities }
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10_second.2010.b
		set_variable = antq_m10_celestial_masters_compact_path
		add_gold = -18
		add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = { factor = 1.6 stability < 0 }
			modifier = { factor = 0.6 gold < 30 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10_second.2010.c
		set_variable = antq_m10_celestial_masters_command_path
		add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_bonus
		add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
			modifier = { factor = 1.75 at_war = yes }
			modifier = { factor = 0.25 monthly_manpower < 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Antonine Plague; ANTIQVITAS master plan §9; SCI-ANT; recipient=ROM
antq_m10_second.2013 = {
	type = country_event
	title = antq_m10_second.2013.title
	desc = antq_m10_second.2013.desc
	outcome = negative
	fire_only_once = yes
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event/antq_antonine_plague.dds"
	option = {
		name = antq_m10_second.2013.a
		historical_option = yes
		set_variable = antq_m10_antonine_plague_chronicle_path
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
			modifier = { factor = 1.24 stability >= 20 }
			modifier = { factor = 0.84 at_war = yes }
		}
		add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_penalty
		add_manpower = { value = root.monthly_manpower multiply = -6 }
		add_gold = { value = root.monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = -4 }
		# SCI-ANT: Antioch is an eastern-circuit anchor, not a claimed first case.
		location:antioch = {
			spawn_disease = {
				disease = disease:smallpox
				value = 0.35
			}
			province = { change_province_food_percentage = -0.15 }
		}
		c:XAR = {
			add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
			add_manpower = { value = monthly_manpower multiply = -3 }
			add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = -2 }
			# A separate outbreak proxy avoids asserting one intercontinental chain.
			location:luoyang = {
				spawn_disease = {
					disease = disease:smallpox
					value = 0.20
				}
				province = { change_province_food_percentage = -0.08 }
			}
		}
		capital.market = {
			add_goods_supply = {
				goods = goods:antq_cured_meat
				amount = market_goods_mild_loss
			}
		}
		# Learned practice shapes the response; it never gates the current.
		if = {
			limit = { has_advance = antq_cataphract_adoption }
			add_army_tradition = army_tradition_weak_bonus
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10_second.2013.b
		set_variable = antq_m10_antonine_plague_compact_path
		add_gold = -24
		add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = { factor = 1.6 stability < 0 }
			modifier = { factor = 0.6 gold < 30 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10_second.2013.c
		set_variable = antq_m10_antonine_plague_command_path
		add_manpower = { value = monthly_manpower multiply = -1 }
		add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
		add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_bonus
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
			modifier = { factor = 1.75 at_war = yes }
			modifier = { factor = 0.25 monthly_manpower < 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Daqin Embassy; ANTIQVITAS master plan §9; recipient=HAN

		to = 167.1.1
		monthly_chance = 100
	}

				goods = goods:silk

# Champa Founded; ANTIQVITAS master plan §9; CHAM-BIRTH; recipient=HAN
antq_m10_second.2017 = {
	type = country_event
	title = antq_m10_second.2017.title
	desc = antq_m10_second.2017.desc
	outcome = positive
	fire_only_once = yes
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event/antq_champa_formation.dds"
	dynamic_historical_event = {
		tag = XAR
		from = 192.1.1
		to = 193.1.1
		monthly_chance = 100
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10_second.2017.a
		historical_option = yes
		set_variable = antq_m10_champa_formation_chronicle_path
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
			modifier = { factor = 1.24 stability >= 20 }
			modifier = { factor = 0.84 at_war = yes }
		}
		# CHAM-BIRTH; Linyi/Rinan local-mesh proxy, documented in docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md.
		location:amarendrapura = {
			create_country_from_location = {
				define_unique_country_tag = CPC
				change_country_name = CPC
				change_country_adjective = CPC
				change_country_color = map_CPC
				change_country_flag = CPC
				change_culture = culture:antq_austronesian
				change_religion = religion:antq_austronesian_religion
				change_government_type = government_type:monarchy
				add_reform = government_reform:antq_regional_kingship
				change_heir_selection = heir_selection:cognatic_primogeniture
			}
			add_core = c:CPC
		}
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					this = location:phon_nha
					this = location:visnupura
					this = location:vrddha_ratnapura
				}
			}
			change_location_owner = c:CPC
			add_core = c:CPC
		}
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		# Learned practice shapes the response; it never gates the current.
		if = {
			limit = { has_advance = antq_jurists_law }
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10_second.2017.b
		set_variable = antq_m10_champa_formation_compact_path
		add_gold = -20
		add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = { factor = 1.6 stability < 0 }
			modifier = { factor = 0.6 gold < 30 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10_second.2017.c
		set_variable = antq_m10_champa_formation_command_path
		add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_bonus
		add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
			modifier = { factor = 1.75 at_war = yes }
			modifier = { factor = 0.25 monthly_manpower < 1 }
		}
	}
}
